_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. mekiki works without it; only org-specific checks are skipped.
_comment_profile: Which runtime the corpus targets. 'claude-code' (the default) knows the extension keys and the 1,536-character skill-listing cap. 'generic' checks the Agent Skills specification only, so Claude Code extensions such as when_to_use are reported as non-standard and no listing cap applies.
_comment_limits: Numeric thresholds. Omit to take the profile's values; an entry here wins over them, and 0 turns a check off.
_comment_guards: Guard skill names per risk tier, used by rules L8 and L20. A tier with no entry is not checked, because only your org knows the name.
_comment_patterns: Detection patterns (regexp). The built-in defaults are bilingual (English + Japanese), so most users need nothing here. Override a key to replace it entirely; overrides are case-insensitive unless you write your own flag group.
